SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT sv01.cstmr_id , sv02.deal_sttmn_no , sv02.deal_sttmn_seq , sv02.ordr_no , sv02.ordr_seq , DECODE(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sv01.cstmr_id,sv02.deal_sttmn_no ORDER BY sv01.cstmr_id,sv02.deal_sttmn_no,sv02.deal_sttmn_seq desc),1,'Y','N') as IS_HEAD FROM KEPCON.KEPMPSV01 SV01, KEPCON.KEPMPSV02 SV02 WHERE SV01.CSTMR_ID = 'KRHWAS0031C001' AND SV01.DEAL_STTMN_NO = SV02.DEAL_STTMN_NO AND SV01.SND_CHK = 'N' order by sv01.cstmr_id, sv02.deal_sttmn_no, sv02.deal_sttmn_seq
